# Abderrahman ES-SEBYITY

> Portfolio and technical blog of Abderrahman ES-SEBYITY, a Full-Stack Software Developer and Data Scientist (M.Sc. in Data Science & Analytics, Cadi Ayyad University, Morocco). Specializes in React, Next.js, Django, Node.js, Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LLMs, RAG, and Generative AI. Engineered an 11-stage Multilingual Agentic RAG system resolving Moroccan public-service inquiries across Modern Standard Arabic, Moroccan Darija, Arabizi, and French on a single consumer GPU (hybrid BM25 + BGE-M3 retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, and NLI verification).

## Full Knowledge Base
- [Full LLM Knowledge File](https://abderrahman-essebyity.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Exhaustive markdown dossier covering all system architectures, benchmarks, code stacks, and published technical articles.
